The rounds sheet

Laurence can take on a regular garden service, one-off maintenance, or more specific jobs like turfing and small tree removal. Whether it is a general tidy, a big clear out or refreshing soil and plants.

Regular visits

A regular garden service, so the garden stays kept.

  • General garden maintenancePruning, weeding, mowing and tidying. Regular visits, or a single visit.
  • Lawn careMowing, scarifying (removing moss), grass-seeding and turfing.

One-off jobs

More specific jobs, done once.

  • Hedge trimmingPetrol hedge trimming and tree pruning.
  • Shrub, small tree and ivy removal
  • Waste collection and disposalPlus the tipper van for any larger jobs.
  • Small garden designPlanting, hedge planting, laying membrane and stones, refreshing soil, pots and hanging baskets.
  • PaintingSheds and outdoor walls, and wood preserving.

Bigger jobs

For anything larger there is the van, and a team of landscapers who can be called in. Together they take on turfing, fencing and garden design.

  • Large turfing, fencing and garden designQuoted after a free visit.
Having recently moved to York, we came across Laurence’s gardening services on the internet. Laurence has since done the big spring clean of our patio garden and several rounds of maintenance. Not only is he a very friendly guy, but he is also very good at what he does! Careful with the plants and thorough with weeding. I’d strongly recommend Laurence to anyone who is in need of any gardening work.Hendrik KraetzschmarReview on Laurence’s website
